profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at MyVest
profile.summary:
I didn't know what I was getting into when I picked "Computer Technician" as a specialty back in Middle School (the other options were Typist/Secretary and Auto Mechanic).

But after 3 decades I'm still amazed at how the industry exploded and keeps growing with so many exciting products and opportunities.

I've been involved in almost all levels of software development: technical support, application specialist, programming, full cycle development, testing, system administration, team & tech lead.

I look forward to working everyday, and keep wondering how lucky to have taken that decision.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Staff Software Engineer for the Operations Technologies team

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- As part of the Core DBS Dev Team I was responsible for maintaining and improving the current infrastructure, as well as expanding the existing stale documentation
- Working in Sprints to help provide a regular pace for fixes and features, I also started regular Dev Meeting to more easily spread the current knowledge and start creating a run book for our support issues
- Leading Dev Team in integrating with a new source system, ensuring we worked with QA from the start, and proposed design for easy maintainability and expansion for the same source system but new or different data points (sports, leagues, etc.)
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · SQL · Shell Scripting · Core Java · Software Design · Spring Framework · Sprints · Team Leadership

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
As part of the Integration Services team I have been responsible for ensuring clients, both internal and external, have the best possible access to publish and consume all kinds of data across the enterprise. Initially I was responsible for designing, coding, and testing the following efforts:

● Modify existing TIBCO BusinessWorks interfaces to facilitate capture and validation of customer emails to improve marketing digital outreach
● Maintain and upgrade our Java Spring Framework OAuth solution.

I was part of the push for modernizing our interfaces and, in collaboration with our team, transitioned to expose the majority of our interfaces as APIs for ease of consumption, using TIBCO Mashery as our API Management Platform.

I also started to lead the following projects, from a development perspective:
● Create a unique endpoint and process to compile all financial transactions to be reported under Anti-Money Laundering (AML) IRS requirements. This allowed me to gain specific knowledge in the AML domain, and become the main technical contact.
● Multiple projects in the gaming domain (slot machines, sports betting, casino floor self-service kiosks, etc.), involving a multitude of external clients requiring access to new and existing interfaces, which we provided as easily accessible HTTP APIs instead of other internal protocols (TIBCO EMS, TIBCO RV, JDBC, AS/400).

These experiences have also helped me expand my soft skills to contribute and communicate much more effectively with all stakeholders as well with the small team of developers under my charge, making it possible to deliver to our clients the products they need with the quality they expect.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Spring Framework · Team Leadership · TIBCO BusinessWorks · TIBCO EMS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a contributor in this growing company, I had different "hats": Developer, System Administrator, Architect.

I'm helping re-work our main software systems to become more resilient with multi-threading, load-balancing and fail-over capabilities.

As a telecommunications provider we have had to work with standard specifications. In this role I dealt mainly with RADIUS, our AAA system, modifying it to handle multiple concurrent sessions and adding new features to make it more responsive.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Java · RADIUS · Telecommunications Systems · Spring Framework · Software Architecture

positions.title: Principal Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
I was one of the first developers in the Oracle Mexico Development Center started in 2010; we served as an example that Mexico has the skills and talent to bring even more projects into the Center, it has now grown to over 500 people.
As a VOS Developer I helped design, implement and test changes in the lower layer of the Oracle Database; this layer is what helps the Oracle Database be multi-platform.

*	Solved bugs in different modules, which helped me to know the product better and be capable of solving problems outside the modules I was focused on.
*	Helped implement the use of a new framework to notify processes with a wait/post mechanism, migrating current internal clients to it and providing support to clients from other areas.
*	Coded changes for the handling of a cluster-level locking mechanism that now allows the database layer developers to introduce multiple levels of locking, integrating existing conflict and hang algorithms to handle and diagnose possible deadlocks, all of this automatically avoiding previous attempts to have each developer to implement their own solution.
*	After a few months solving bugs and implementing changes in different modules, started to focus on the handling of database parameters, both at startup time and at runtime, assisting in bringing in specific features and improvements to this module.
*	Helped define, design and implement a feature to “specialize” nodes in a cluster by specifying different parameter values only to certain a group of instances in the cluster, simplifying the management of parameter files and allowing a better allocation of resources.
*	Involved in the selection and hiring process, helping interview applicants and giving feedback to the manager.
*	Helped train and assist new hires into their positions, both in the technical aspects of the job and the administrative processes followed by the company.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Relational Databases · Multithreaded Development · Database Development · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Developer / SysAdmin
positions.description:
FaMexSoft is now a Hildebrando incorporated company, now part of one the biggest software companies in Mexico.
As a software engineer, I analyzed new user requirements, wrote their specifications, designed and then coded the appropriate implementation.
When I started as a developer, our team was responsible only for one key IBM internal application; about one and a half years later, the Raleigh-based client transferred us four related applications.

*	The first application the team took over was based on Java Swing, Java Servlets with a DB2 backend; because of the previous experience we had with the technologies, within weeks we started delivering patches.
*	Server administration and development of the first application was taken over by myself and another team member, after the four new applications were transferred to us, and the rest of the team. A few months later, the application and servers no longer needed continuous maintenance and tuning; I then became responsible for the main application.
*	Suggested to step back and rethink our approaches to some complex requirements, after noticing we could start falling into "development hell".
*	Migrated main application to a new 64-bit server because of the increased memory requirements for handling the bigger data sets being queried by the users; this was achieved in a little over three months with very few weekend downtime hours.
*	Introduced changes to the development process to help accelerate the time from concept to installation, started automating compilation, build, continuous integration, certain testing and deployment. Before leaving, the time from finishing coding to deployment was reduced from a day to minutes.
*	The whole team accepted the role of early adopter for PSP practices; this has caused the organization to deploy new practices, guidelines and processes after reviewing the increased performance and greatly reduced defect rate.

positions.title: Application Specialist / Tester
positions.description:
As a Tester I learned the application throughout, developed and used test cases to analyze how well the application implemented the user requirements and specifications. This also meant keeping track of which test cases were exercised, how many passed or not, and helping put together a final report of all tests along with an assessment of the risks of deploying the application to the production environment.
As an application specialist, I analyzed defects sent by the users, tracking and following up with both users and developers to come to a solution. This included exercising the user case to reproduce the problem, and if appropriate, restating these for the developers to have a clear and concise way to reproduce it in their environments.
Our team was both Mexico and France-based, because of this we were in direct communication only a couple hours per day. We developed mechanisms to transfer pending tasks at the end of the day to be completed by the other team.

*	Used Lotus Notes databases to keep track of all defects, test cases and reports.
*	Suggested a daily report as the main way to keep track of all our activities, with highlights of the day and any follow-through needed for/from the other team.
*	As a local team, we had a daily chat room to respond quickly on the functional and user test phases.
*	Two major releases required us to align our work time with France’s time, to help focus the team on the acceptance and deployment phases.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
ContPAQi (before Computacion en Accion, CompAc) is a small company that develops the widely used AdminPAQ, ContPAQ, NomiPAQ and related products.

As a Tester I learned the basics of some of the applications, and then helped develop and exercise tests to find functionality and GUI defects.

*	Used Lotus Notes databases to track all defects and test cases.
*	Performed functional and installation tests.
*	Analyzed bug reports from internal testing.

positions.title: Server Admin
positions.description:
CUCEA is the University's campus focused on the finance, management and administration degrees.
As a Server Admin I helped support and maintain the campus IT infrastructure.
*	Developed and maintained a better backup strategy for the main servers (e-mail, forums and file shares).
*	Used platform tools and shell scripts to perform and/or automate administrative tasks.

testScores.name: College Board, Prueba de Actitud Académica
testScores.description:
Due to the limited availability of seats in the public government-funded college, Universidad de Guadalajara, all applicants are required to take this test. Each degree has a set number of seats, and the score of this test plus the previous education level GPA determines who is allowed to join.

The PAA is designed to assess the aptitude for college of students who have completed ten to eleven years of education and whose dominant language is Spanish.[1]

[1] Description translated from: http://oprla.collegeboard.com/ptorico/latinam/program/paa.html
